title: LAMP Fellowship (Legislative Assistants to Members of Parliament)
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 25 years or younger with at least a bachelor's degree in any discipline.
notes: Places fellows with an MP for one parliamentary year (June–May); applications typically open in November with two policy/essay prompts followed by interviews.

title: NITI Aayog Young Professionals (YP) Programme
eligibility: Master's degree or professional degree (BE/BTech/LLB/PG Diploma) under age 32 with at least 1 year of relevant post-qualification experience.
notes: Two-year contract (extendable) at Rs 70,000/month across NITI verticals; vacancies are advertised in batches throughout the year, often peaking in spring and autumn.

title: NITI Aayog Internship Scheme
eligibility: Bonafide undergraduate, postgraduate (including MPP), or research students at recognized universities with required minimum marks.
notes: Online portal opens strictly from the 1st to the 10th of every month; apply 2 months in advance of your desired start month (e.g., March/April for summer).

title: Chief Minister's Fellowship Programme – Maharashtra (CMFP)
eligibility: Graduates aged 21–26 with First Class degree, at least 1 year of work experience, and proficiency in Marathi.
notes: 12-month fellowship placing young professionals with District Collectors, CEOs of Zilla Parishads, or Mantralaya Secretaries; includes online objective test and interview.

title: Chief Minister's Good Governance Associates (CMGGA) – Haryana
orgName: Government of Haryana & Ashoka University / Samagra
eligibility: Indian citizens under age 28 with a post-graduate degree or up to 3 years of work experience after graduation.
notes: One-year district-level governance fellowship placing one Associate in each of Haryana's 22 districts, working closely with the Deputy Commissioner and CM's Office.

title: Chief Minister's Fellowship Program – Tamil Nadu (TNCFP)
orgName: Government of Tamil Nadu & BIM Tiruchirappalli
eligibility: First-class Bachelor's or Master's degree holders aged 22–30 with working proficiency in Tamil.
notes: Two-year fellowship assigning fellows to thematic cells in Secretariat departments and districts; carries an academic Postgraduate Certificate in Public Policy and Management.

title: Karnataka Chief Minister's Fellowship / Young Professionals Programme
orgName: Planning, Programme Monitoring and Statistics Department, Government of Karnataka
eligibility: Postgraduates in public policy, economics, social sciences, or engineering with strong analytical skills; Kannada knowledge preferred.
notes: Places young policy professionals inside the Karnataka State Policy and Planning Commission and key line departments in Bengaluru and districts.

title: SBI Youth for India Fellowship
eligibility: Indian citizens, OCIs, or citizens of Nepal/Bhutan aged 21–32 holding a bachelor's degree prior to fellowship commencement.
notes: 13-month paid rural development fellowship partnering with 13+ premier NGOs (BAIF, Barefoot College, Aga Khan Rural Support Programme, etc.).

title: Gandhi Fellowship
eligibility: Final-year undergraduate/postgraduate students or recent graduates under 26 years with strong campus leadership track records.
notes: Two-year residential grassroot systems-transformation fellowship across Aspirational Districts focusing on public school education, digital health, and tribal health.

title: Teach For India Fellowship
eligibility: Indian citizens or OCIs with at least a Bachelor's degree before June of the cohort year.
notes: Two-year full-time paid fellowship teaching in under-resourced schools across 8 Indian cities; recruits in 4 rounds between August and March.

title: Young India Fellowship (YIF)
eligibility: Graduates or final-year students of any discipline with a recognized undergraduate or postgraduate degree; no upper age limit.
notes: One-year residential multidisciplinary Postgraduate Diploma in Liberal Studies with an Experiential Learning Module (ELM) client project; need-based and Chancellor's scholarships available.

title: World Bank Young Professionals Program (WBG YPP)
eligibility: Born on or after October 1 (under 32), Master's degree plus 4+ years of relevant policy/operations experience or PhD in relevant field.
notes: Premier 5-year leadership track across IBRD, IFC, and MIGA; applications open exclusively in September each year.

title: World Bank Bank Internship Program (BIP)
eligibility: Undergraduate degree holders currently enrolled in a full-time graduate study program (Master's or PhD, including MPP).
notes: Paid summer internship (May–August) in Washington, D.C. or country offices including New Delhi; application window typically runs mid-January to mid-February.

title: United Nations Secretariat Internship Programme (UN Careers)
orgName: United Nations Secretariat (UN ESCAP / DESA / UNEP)
eligibility: Enrolled in a graduate school programme (second university degree or equivalent, such as MPP) or within 1 year of graduation.
notes: Rolling postings on Inspira (careers.un.org) for New York, Geneva, Bangkok (UN ESCAP), and New Delhi; filter Job Network by Economic, Social and Development.

title: UNDP India Policy & Programme Internship
eligibility: Enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as MPP, Economics, Development Studies) or graduated within the past 12 months.
notes: Stipend-bearing internships based in New Delhi across SDG Coordination, Climate Action, Inclusive Growth, and Accelerator Lab teams.

title: ADB Young Professionals Program (YPP)
eligibility: Hold a Master's or PhD in economics, public policy, finance, or engineering, aged 32 or younger, with at least 3 years of relevant professional experience.
notes: Three-year foundational career track at ADB HQ in Manila with rotational assignments in regional departments.

title: IMF Fund Internship Program (FIP)
eligibility: PhD or Master's students in macroeconomics, public finance, international trade, or financial regulation under age 32 (Master's candidates must be under 28).
notes: 10–12 week paid summer internship in Washington, D.C. (June–August); applications open in October and close in December.

title: OECD Young Associates Programme (YAP)
orgName: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
eligibility: Recent undergraduate or Master's graduates with top academic grades and plans to pursue further graduate study after the 24-month placement.
notes: Two-year paid policy research associate role in Paris; OECD also runs a rolling Internship Programme open to nationals/students in policy programs.

title: WHO Global & Country Office Internship Programme
eligibility: At least 20 years old and enrolled in a graduate/postgraduate program in public health, public policy, health economics, or medicine.
notes: 6–24 week placements at WHO SEARO (New Delhi), WHO Country Office India, or Geneva HQ; living allowance provided to eligible interns.

title: PRS Legislative Research Internship
eligibility: Undergraduate and postgraduate students in public policy, law, political science, or economics.
notes: 4–8 week rolling internships (with peak summer intake applications in Feb–April) assisting analysts on legislative briefs and standing committee summaries.

title: Centre for Policy Research (CPR) Research Internship
eligibility: Advanced undergraduate and Master's/MPP students with strong qualitative or quantitative policy research skills.
notes: Initiative-specific internships across Climate Initiative, Urbanisation, Accountability Initiative, and State Capacity; apply with writing sample and CV.

title: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Internship Programme
orgName: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 25 or younger who are final-year graduates or recent graduates/postgraduates from recognized institutions.
notes: Recruits in two terms per year (Term I: April–Sept, applications in Jan–Feb; Term II: Oct–March, applications in July–Aug) with Rs 10,000/month honorarium and return airfare.

title: MyGov Internship Programme
orgName: MyGov, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
eligibility: Undergraduate or postgraduate students in public policy, management, communications, data analytics, or computer science.
notes: Places interns in public policy research, citizen engagement, and data analytics teams at MyGov India in New Delhi.

title: Graduate Certificate in Public Policy (GCPP)
eligibility: Students and working professionals with a bachelor's degree; offered in Defense & Foreign Affairs, Technology & Policy, and Advanced Public Policy tracks.
notes: 12-week networked online cohort program run 3 times a year (Spring, Summer, Autumn) with weekend workshops and policy memo capstones.

title: IDinsight Associate / Junior Economist Recruitment Cycle
eligibility: Bachelor's or Master's (MPP/MPA/Economics) graduates with strong econometrics, Stata/R/Python proficiency, and field research experience.
notes: Main global campus/fresh-graduate recruitment wave runs September–November for July/August start dates in New Delhi; includes technical data test and case interview.

title: J-PAL South Asia Research Associate / Policy Associate Recruitment
eligibility: Bachelor's or Master's degree with coursework in microeconomics, econometrics, and development economics plus Stata/R skills.
notes: Peak hiring cycle for RA and Policy & Training Associate roles across Indian state project sites runs from October through February.

title: Rhodes Scholarship for India
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18–23 (or up to 27 if completing first undergraduate degree late) with a First Class Honours degree.
notes: Funds 2–3 years of fully funded postgraduate study (including the MPP at the Blavatnik School of Government or DPhil) at Oxford; 5–6 scholars selected from India annually.

title: Chevening India Scholarships & Fellowships
eligibility: Indian citizens with an undergraduate degree and at least 2 years (2,800 hours) of work experience (including internships/volunteering).
notes: Fully funded UK Master's scholarships plus short-term mid-career fellowships (Chevening Cyber Security, Science & Innovation Leadership, South Asia Journalism).

title: Schwarzman Scholars
eligibility: Candidates aged 18–28 with an undergraduate degree and demonstrated leadership in public policy, economics, business, or international affairs.
notes: Fully funded one-year Master's in Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing; global cycle closes in September.

title: Inlaks Shivdasani Scholarship
eligibility: Indian passport holders residing in India under age 30 holding an offer to a top-tier graduate program in the UK, Europe, or US.
notes: Provides up to USD 100,000 towards tuition and living expenses for public policy, social sciences, law, and climate studies.

title: Google Public Policy Fellowship
eligibility: Undergraduate, graduate (MPP/Law), or PhD students interested in internet and AI policy.
notes: Paid summer/semester fellowship placing students at leading tech-policy think tanks and civil society organizations.

title: Mozilla Fellowships (Tech + Society)
eligibility: Policy researchers, technologists, digital rights advocates, and lawyers working on trustworthy AI and open internet governance in the Majority World.
notes: 10–12 month funded fellowship embedding researchers with host civil-society organizations or independent AI accountability projects.

title: Horizon Fellowship (Emerging Technology & Public Policy)
eligibility: Early- and mid-career professionals and graduate students focusing on AI governance, biosecurity, and emerging technology policy.
notes: Fully funded 6–24 month policy placements in executive agencies, legislative offices, and leading emerging-tech think tanks.

title: Youth Parliament & Public Policy Fellowship (NFPRC)
eligibility: Postgraduate students and young researchers in public policy, political science, law, and economics.
notes: Research fellowship and policy internship cohorts working on governance indices, flagship central schemes, and constituency development briefs.
